title.narrative: Promote an Inclusive and human focused IA for the judicatory, students and media

description.narrative: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI), including generative AI and multimodal systems, is transforming societies, enhancing creativity, optimizing workflows, and driving economic growth. However, AI's benefits will not be evenly distributed, potentially exacerbating inequality and labour market disruptions. To ensure AI's ethical development and mitigate risks such as bias and privacy violations, robust human oversight, particularly from the judiciary, is crucial. Beyond its role in AI governance, the judiciary can also adopt AI to improve efficiency and access to justice, but in doing so, it must ensure that AI tools uphold fairness, accountability, and human rights, embedding these principles into their operations to modernize while safeguarding fundamental rights. The sector of Communication and Information will reinforce the work undertaken by the Social and Human Sciences programme to foster interdisciplinary dialogue, advance ethical guidelines, regulatory frameworks, and policies that prioritize fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI development and deployment. Through this collaboration, UNESCO will ensure that ethical AI governance is widely understood and effectively implemented, fostering AI systems that serve humanity responsibly. The focus of the plan will be on the judiciary.
